episodes.synopsis: Suddenly, a masked wrestler and space mask science fiction that forces Antonio Inoki to challenge appeared. He was an assassin sent by the mysterious organization, the Space Pro-Wrestling Federation. Space mask science fiction that bursts into the ring and challenges Inoki. There, a man with a tiger mask appeared like a gale. He calls himself Tiger Mask II, the successor of Naoto Date's will!
episodes.title: Howl! The Oath of the Ring

episodes.synopsis: The Space Pro-Wrestling Federation begins to explore the identity of Tiger Mask. The defeated space mask science fiction approaches Inoki to rematch Tiger. But Inoki didn't know the whereabouts of Tiger... At that time, Tiger appears in front of Inoki and begins to talk about his true identity. There is also a huge evil shadow approaching in the Japanese professional wrestling world...
episodes.title: The Man Who Was Forged in the Hole of the Tiger

episodes.synopsis: Space mask SF that lost the first game and burned with revenge. A one-game game between him and Tiger Mask was about to begin. In this game, each other's masks are supposed to be bet. As soon as the gong rings, the exchange of advanced techniques begins. The tiger that is gradually being driven into inferiority explodes with the special move of the space mask!
episodes.title: The Battle to Death in Masks

episodes.synopsis: A terrible conspiracy was revealed by Space Mask SF. The Space Professional Wrestling Federation was trying to take over the Japanese professional wrestling world. Moreover, the Space Professional Wrestling Federation will immediately send in a second assassin. It's The Bat, which is good at simitling attacks. Bat defeats the popular villain wrestler Bigwood and forces Tiger to confront him!
episodes.title: Tora, Inhaler of Blood

episodes.synopsis: Tatsuo begins to investigate the disappearance of some high school students, all of them emerged in various sports.
episodes.title: Youth Hunting

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Mask II and the police rescue the boys from the ship.
episodes.title: The Burning Fight Spirit

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Mask II takes Inoki by car to the foot of Mount Fuji by showing him, through the crack of the trunk of a tree, a pyramid, which for years has remained hidden by vegetation.
episodes.title: Puzzle of Tiger Perimeter

episodes.synopsis: Mister Who N ° 1 and N ° 2 have just arrived by plane in Japan, while Midori informs Tatsuo that the true identity of Kyuketsu-Kamen The Bat has been discovered.
episodes.title: Decisive Battle! Tag Match

episodes.synopsis: The match against Mister Who N ° 1 and N ° 2 is becoming a massacre, in fact they are dominating the match by attacking their opponents in two against one as Inoki and Tiger Mask II persist in fighting loyally.
episodes.title: Dangerous! Japanese Pro Wrestling

episodes.synopsis: At the airport Tatsuo meets Rita, a friend and American journalist.
episodes.title: The Challenge of Iron Mask

episodes.synopsis: Tiger mask faces iron mask but he notes that there is something familiar in the Iron Mask technique, equal to that of Rita.
episodes.title: The Cold-Hearted Rule

episodes.synopsis: The mysterious head of the Space Wrestling Federation decides to go personally to Japan to attend the tag match where their new masked wrestlers.
episodes.title: The Hawk of Hell

episodes.synopsis: Tatsuo learns that Emir Arman Hassan, with whom Japan has entered into an agreement for the sale and purchase of oil, will come to Yokohama aboard his luxury ship.
episodes.title: The Thousand Knocks of Shigeo Nagashima

episodes.synopsis: Tatsuo is working out the counter-move with which to beat the Hawk of Hell
episodes.title: Immortal Champion Belt

episodes.synopsis: The day of the match against the Hell Hawks has arrived, Hassan also attends the match sitting in a front row seat.
episodes.title: A Space Professional Wrestling Union!?

episodes.synopsis: Nobody welcomes the fact that Inoki and Tiger Mask II do not want to sell New Japan Pro-Wrestling to Hassan despite the fact that he threatens to no longer distribute oil to Japan.
episodes.title: Tatsuo Aku Approaches Hassan

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Mask, attacked by Hassan's rugby team, remembers his youth in the United States, studied in New York and worked for a newsroom.
episodes.title: Recollection: Pro Wrestling's Way

episodes.synopsis: A helicopter lands on the Oil King, the passenger is Seido Muscle, a huge savage who will be the partner of Shinigami Silver in the upcoming tag match against Inoki and Tiger Mask II.
episodes.title: Trap! One Second Before Gong

episodes.synopsis: The tag match begins and Tiger Mask II faces Shinigami Silver whose build has claws and sharp horns with which it puts the opponent in difficulty.
episodes.title: Death God Silver's Betrayal

episodes.synopsis: Shinigami Silver and Tiger Mask II face off in a great match but are then interrupted by Geller and his hit men.
episodes.title: Crash! Tiger Hurricane

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Mask II trains with Inoki asking him to fight alone against Seido Muscle.
episodes.title: Hassan's Secret

episodes.synopsis: The match begins but Seido Muscle does not suffer the attacks of Tiger Mask II thanks to his muscles.
episodes.title: Push Down Bronze Muscle!

episodes.synopsis: Abdullah the Butcher, a strong and famous Canadian wrestler, wants to challenge Tiger Mask II in a match.
episodes.title: Butcher's Condition of Challenge

episodes.synopsis: Butcher gives Midori a private interview and reveals his past, the humiliations and sufferings he has suffered but which he has overcome, in addition to the motivations that led him to challenge Tiger Mask II in a match to the death.
episodes.title: Tiger VS Butcher

episodes.synopsis: Butcher puts Tiger Mask II in difficulty with his fast karate techniques, despite the masked wrestler defends himself very well, but Butcher starts fighting not respecting the rules.
episodes.title: Men's Battle

episodes.synopsis: American wrestlers not finding it right that the Space Wrestling Federation only fights against New Japan Pro-Wrestling decide to come forward, in fact one of them, Stan Hansen, challenges Devil Puma.
episodes.title: The Anger of Shun Hansen

episodes.synopsis: The night of the match between Tiger Mask II and Devil Puma has arrived.
episodes.title: The Gun Which Calls the Storm

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Mask II and Devil Puma face off in a match with no time limit, in a clash where both demonstrate that they have practically the same strength.
episodes.title: Devil Chop of Fear

episodes.synopsis: Tatsuo brings Giena to Hakone and then two helicopters arrive, which suspects Tatsuo in fact those are the hit men of the Space Wrestling Federation. Geller, accompanied by Devil Puma, tries to kill Giena.
episodes.title: Fly! Tatsuo Aku

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Mask II continues to fight against Devil Puma, who puts him in serious trouble with his deadly karate moves.
episodes.title: Shivering Battle Royale

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Mask II reaches the ring for Battle Royale, then riding a horse comes Hakuma Knight, the second strongest wrestler in the Space Wrestling Federation.
episodes.title: Hassan's Fire Blowing Anger

episodes.synopsis: Hassan proposes that the strongest wrestler in the Space Wrestling Federation fight against André The Giant.
episodes.title: The Gong's High Ringing Decisive Battle

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Mask II and The Strongs continue to fight in an exceptional match.
episodes.title: The Unwanted Result at the Battle's Conclusion
